title: 3129. Find All Possible Stable Binary Arrays I

examples.explanation: The two possible stable binary arrays are [1,0] and [0,1], as both arrays have a single 0 and a single 1, and no subarray has a length greater than 2.
The only possible stable binary array is [1,0,1]. Note that the binary arrays [1,1,0] and [0,1,1] have subarrays of length 2 with identical elements, hence, they are not stable.
